Verifier notes and special checks

Forty-eight printed bars, all in 2/4: eight on system 1, then six, ten, ten, six, and eight. The upper staff opens in the treble clef and the lower staff in the bass clef, each with one sharp. Systems 2 through 6 reprint those clefs, and no clef change is printed. System 1 carries the opening 2/4 and closes bar 8 with an end repeat. A start repeat opens bar 9 and an end repeat closes bar 12. A double bar closes bar 20, and another closes bar 28. A start repeat opens bar 37 and an end repeat closes bar 40. Bar 48 ends with the final barline. There is no pickup, and no bar is split across a system break. The printed barlines of system 1 match the proposed frame.

  • System 1, right end of the eighth bar: Is the closing sign one barline, or does the thick stroke add a region? One end repeat. The thin stroke is at crop x 1626 and the thick stroke is at crop x 1634 through 1639. Two stacked dots sit in each staff immediately left of the thin stroke.
  • System 1 into system 2: Does the eighth bar continue onto the next system? No. System 1 ends on a complete end-repeat barline, and system 2 begins a new bar on a start repeat.
  • System 1, barline between the first and second bars: The stroke leans. Which crop x is the barline? The stroke is darkest near crop x 562 in the treble and near crop x 565 in the bass. The continuous center through both staves is crop x 563.
